UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting joins the CSIS Europe, Russia, and Eurasia program to discuss the future of U.S.-UK defense cooperation, including how the Special Relationship is adapting as Europe rearms, burden shifting reshapes NATO, and a new UK government sets its priorities.

Could Russia Be Poised to Use an On-Orbit Weapon Against a Commercial Satellite?

Cosmos 2612 is moving into position for close-proximity operations with a U.S.-registered commercial satellite supporting Ukraine. With a history of on orbit weapons tests and gray zone aggression, Russia may be betting the West won’t respond forcefully to an attack. The West must be ready to.

“Bunker Busters”: Deep Targets, Shallow Stocks
